title: From Salt Lake city : small group tour to Zion National Park
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join a small group adventure from Salt Lake City and experience the breathtaking landscapes of southern Utah on this full-day tour to Zion National Park. Travel in comfort as you journey through the stunning Virgin River Gorge, a dramatic canyon carved by the Virgin River and known for its towering cliffs and colorful rock formations.

Continue into Zion National Park, where you’ll explore one of America’s most iconic natural wonders. Stop at the Zion Canyon Visitor Center to take in your first views of the park’s massive sandstone cliffs and learn about its unique geology and history. Then enjoy time inside Zion National Park, surrounded by towering rock walls, deep canyons, and spectacular desert scenery with plenty of opportunities for photos and sightseeing.

This small group experience ensures a more personal and relaxed journey, allowing you to fully enjoy the beauty and grandeur of Zion at a comfortable pace.
